name: Goutokuji Ayari
source:
A big-breasted married woman. She is a gorgeous celebrity madam. 28 years old. She is the leader of the housewives.

She is a client of Noa's company. She loves her husband, but his parents do not like at her at all. Her husband views her as a status symbol.
